# Memory scanning (`scan`)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate.mjs. Do not edit; run `npm run generate` (drift fails `npm run check`). -->

Area `scan` is owned by WP10-SCAN; its contracts live in `src/contracts/areas/scan.ts`.

## `scan_memory` — Scan Memory

Start a Cheat-Engine-style scan handle over target memory: exact value (ints, f32/f64 with epsilon, byte pattern with ?? wildcards, utf8/utf16 text), between two values, unknown initial value (snapshot in the target), or pointers to an address. Returns only scan_id and hit count; page hits with scan_results and narrow with scan_next. Runs in the background; blocks up to wait_ms. Read-only; snapshots are capped in size.

| Phase | Hints     | Effects                           | Gate | CLI                                                                                     |
| ----- | --------- | --------------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P2    | read-only | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession | —    | scenario: Scan handles are session state; run scans from MCP or as steps of a scenario. |

| Input field  | Type                                                                    | Required | Default    | Description                                                                            |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session_id` | string `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$` | yes      | —          | Session id from spawn_process, attach_process or emu_open.                             |
| `value_type` | "i8" \| "u8" \| "i16" \| "u16" \| "i32" \| "u32" \| "i64" \| "u64" \| … | yes      | —          |                                                                                        |
| `compare`    | "exact" \| "between" \| "unknown" \| "pointer_to"                       | no       | `"exact"`  |                                                                                        |
| `value`      | number \| string ≤800 \| boolean                                        | no       | —          | bytes: pattern like "48 8b ?? 4?"; utf8/utf16: text; ptr, pointer_to: hex or AddrExpr. |
| `value2`     | number \| string ≤800 \| boolean                                        | no       | —          | Upper bound (between).                                                                 |
| `epsilon`    | number 0..1000000000                                                    | no       | —          |                                                                                        |
| `protection` | "rw-" \| "r--" \| "r-x"                                                 | no       | `"rw-"`    |                                                                                        |
| `module`     | string ≤260                                                             | no       | —          | Only this module.                                                                      |
| `kind`       | "all" \| "image" \| "private"                                           | no       | `"all"`    | image: static pointer candidates.                                                      |
| `aligned`    | boolean                                                                 | no       | `true`     |                                                                                        |
| `max_hits`   | integer 1..50000000                                                     | no       | `10000000` |                                                                                        |
| `wait_ms`    | integer 0..60000                                                        | no       | `30000`    |                                                                                        |

Deadline 90,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence when-done as `bea.scan.result` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.

## `scan_next` — Scan Next

Narrow an existing scan by re-reading its hits: exact, between, changed, unchanged, increased, decreased, increased_by or decreased_by (epsilon for floats). Returns the remaining count. When hunting an unknown in-game value, ask the user to change it between calls. Read-only.

| Phase | Hints     | Effects                           | Gate | CLI                                                                                     |
| ----- | --------- | --------------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P2    | read-only | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession | —    | scenario: Scan handles are session state; run scans from MCP or as steps of a scenario. |

| Input field | Type                                                                                                               | Required | Default | Description |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ------- | ----------- |
| `scan_id`   | string `^scan_[0-9a-f]{8}$`                                                                                        | yes      | —       |             |
| `compare`   | "exact" \| "between" \| "changed" \| "unchanged" \| "increased" \| "decreased" \| "increased_by" \| "decreased_by" | yes      | —       |             |
| `value`     | number \| string ≤800 \| boolean                                                                                   | no       | —       |             |
| `value2`    | number \| string ≤800 \| boolean                                                                                   | no       | —       |             |
| `epsilon`   | number 0..1000000000                                                                                               | no       | —       |             |
| `wait_ms`   | integer 0..60000                                                                                                   | no       | `30000` |             |

Deadline 90,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence when-done as `bea.scan.result` · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.

## `scan_results` — Scan Results

Page a scan's hits with current and previous values and address forms; hits inside a module carry module+RVA and static VA (candidates for static pointers). Exhausting pages proves nothing about memory outside the scanned ranges. Read-only.

| Phase | Hints                 | Effects                                       | Gate | CLI                                                                                     |
| ----- | --------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| P2    | read-only, idempotent | readsTargetMemory, mutatesSession, idempotent | —    | scenario: Scan handles are session state; run scans from MCP or as steps of a scenario. |

| Input field | Type                        | Required | Default | Description                |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ------- | -------------------------- |
| `scan_id`   | string `^scan_[0-9a-f]{8}$` | yes      | —       |                            |
| `offset`    | integer 0..100000000        | no       | `0`     |                            |
| `limit`     | integer 1..500              | no       | `50`    |                            |
| `values`    | boolean                     | no       | `true`  | false: stored values only. |

Deadline 30,000 ms · input ≤ 1,048,576 bytes · evidence not recorded · sessions live · results carry untrusted target content.
